content.text: /ext:medcp Which antihypertensive classes are most commonly prescribed in adults 40-60?

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, concept_code, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE vocabulary_id = 'ATC'
  AND concept_code IN ('C02','C03','C07','C08','C09')
ORDER BY concept_code;

arguments.sql_query:
WITH classes AS (
  SELECT concept_id AS class_concept_id, concept_name AS class_name
  FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'ATC'
    AND concept_code IN ('C02','C03','C07','C08','C09')
), exposures AS (
  SELECT
    c.class_name,
    de.person_id,
    de.drug_exposure_id
  FROM classes c
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
    ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = c.class_concept_id
  JOIN omop.drug_exposure de
    ON de.drug_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  JOIN omop.person p
    ON p.person_id = de.person_id
  WHERE de.drug_start_date IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM de.drug_start_date) - p.year_of_birth BETWEEN 40 AND 60
)
SELECT
  class_name,
  COUNT(*) AS prescription_records,
  COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patients
FROM exposures
GROUP BY class_name
ORDER BY patients DESC, prescription_records DESC;

  SELECT concept_id AS class_concept_id, concept_name AS class_name
  FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'ATC'
    AND concept_code IN ('C02','C03','C07','C08','C09')

  JOIN omop.person p

arguments.sql_query:
WITH classes AS (
  SELECT concept_id AS class_concept_id, concept_name AS class_name
  FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'ATC'
    AND concept_code IN ('C02','C03','C07','C08','C09')
), era_hits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.class_name,
    e.person_id,
    e.drug_era_id,
    e.drug_exposure_count
  FROM omop.drug_era e
  JOIN omop.person p
    ON p.person_id = e.person_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
    ON ca.descendant_concept_id = e.drug_concept_id
  JOIN classes c
    ON c.class_concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
  WHERE DATEDIFF(year,
      CAST(COALESCE(p.birth_datetime, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth, 7), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth, 1))) AS date),
      CAST(e.drug_era_start_date AS date)
    ) BETWEEN 40 AND 60
)
SELECT
  class_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patients,
  COUNT(*) AS drug_eras,
  SUM(COALESCE(drug_exposure_count, 1)) AS exposure_count_in_eras
FROM era_hits
GROUP BY class_name
ORDER BY patients DESC, exposure_count_in_eras DESC;

In adults aged 40–60, the most commonly prescribed antihypertensive-related classes were:

| Rank | Drug class | Patients | Drug eras | Exposure count in eras |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | Beta blocking agents | 62,764 | 196,391 | 702,026 |
| 2 | Diuretics | 44,384 | 162,873 | 706,684 |
| 3 | Agents acting on the renin-angiotensin system | 42,243 | 95,494 | 380,527 |
| 4 | Calcium channel blockers | 36,960 | 107,503 | 462,559 |
| 5 | Antihypertensives, ATC C02 | 25,758 | 74,037 | 274,097 |

Method: queried OMOP `drug_era`, mapped ATC classes `C02`, `C03`, `C07`, `C08`, and `C09` through `concept_ancestor`, and counted people whose drug era began when they were 40–60. Ranking is by distinct patients.
